method.positive: Observed dwell >=180 seconds; not fuel truth
method.negative: Every shorter detected encounter; other known candidate stations are candidate negatives
method.candidate_set: All stations observed in that account catalog/visit history by cutoff, with static coordinates, within 25 km; target never injected
method.availability: Phone-recorded/received time respected; server upload delays ignored. Usage uses client occurred_at.
method.model: L2 regularized, encounter weighted, class-balanced logistic regression; fixed regularization .03, threshold .5; not calibrated probability
method.two_stage_gate: Separate unbalanced logistic regression on best-ranked candidate features, trained only on earlier encounters, threshold .5; ranker training scores are in-sample, so gate calibration is exploratory
method.analysis_sequence: Initial ranker/geometry/baselines evaluated first. Gate and personal-route scenarios added after initial results and user steering; all are exploratory on this shared test window, not independent final validation.
limitations: Current static station coordinates, not historical coordinate snapshots
Encounter landmarks know retrospectively an encounter is approaching; continuous evaluation reported separately
Short observation gaps can conceal longer stops; conservative sensitivity excludes these
No traffic, road network, tank level, purchase truth or future context used

full.policy: Every minute; route memory uses nearest same-person prior approach within 300m/45deg and short-stop negative veto; others use threshold .5, >150m from candidate, 30-minute cooldown, maximum 2 alerts/account/UTC day; next encounter within 15 minutes
full.unobserved_outcome: No observed encounter is not proof of no stop; report separately
